login.title: Log in to Inventra
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the inventory management system.
login.phaseNotice: Mini ERP inventory management system with role-based access control (RBAC).
login.demoFilledNotice: Credentials for {role} have been populated into the form. Please click Log In to proceed.
login.invalidCredentials: Email or password is incorrect. Please check and try again.
login.unauthorizedProfile: User profile is invalid or lacks system access authorization.
login.genericError: A system error occurred. Please try again later.

logout.confirmDesc: Are you sure you want to end your current working session?

roles.adminDesc: Comprehensive access to catalog, categories, stock transactions, user management, and system settings.
roles.ownerDesc: Executive oversight, business analytics, mutation audit, CRUD users, and website settings.
roles.staffDesc: Operational access to record stock IN/OUT physical inventory movements and AI drafting.
roles.auditorDesc: Read-only access for stock audits, asset valuation, executive reports, and AI Q&A.
roles.adminGudangDesc: Operational warehouse management, product catalog, categories, and stock mutations.
